name: com.oreethehat.easy-combat
description: Modular data-driven stats, health, damage, defenses, statuses and abilities for Unity.

samples.description: Try a piercing hitscan, explosive fireball with a burning field, and cone attack against targets with different defenses.
Shooter, swept melee, 100/500/1000 projectile volleys and poison combination, with bounded presentation. No third-party dependencies.
Ten editable attack recipes and a ready-to-play firing range. Try a sword sweep, fireball with burning ground, chain orb, beam and more.
Optional adapter. Requires EasyFeedbacks. Includes only EasyCombat integration code.
Connect EasyCombat slows, movement restrictions and knockback/pull to an EasyMovement FPS player. Includes a combat player prefab builder. Requires EasyMovement and its ECM2 installation.
